title: Diagram and tensor comparisons from a lifted finite presentation matrix
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set, $B:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram of finite-type integer algebras [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and $\kappa_i:B_i\to S$ any ring cocone. Let $M$ be an $S$-module and let $S^m\xrightarrow{g}S^n\xrightarrow{f}M\to0$ be a finite free presentation: $f$ is surjective and $\operatorname{im}(g)=\ker(f)$. Fix $i_0\in I$ and a matrix $A_0\in\operatorname{Mat}_{n\times m}(B_{i_0})$ whose image under $\kappa_{i_0}$ is the standard-basis matrix of $g$. Then there exist a nonempty directed preorder $J$, a final functor $F:J\to I$, an abelian-group diagram $D:J\to\mathrm{Ab}$ and a cocone $\nu_j:D_j\to M$, with $B_{Fj}$-module structures on $D_j$, such that each $D_j$ is finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], transitions and cocone legs respect scalars through $B(F(i\to j))$ and $\kappa_{Fj}$, and the maps $B_{Fj}\otimes_{B_{Fi}}D_i\to D_j$ and $S\otimes_{B_{Fj}}D_j\to M$ sending $y\otimes x$ to $y$ times the indicated image of $x$ are linear isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. If $I,B,S$ live in universe $u$ and $M$ in universe $v$, take $J$ in $u$ and $D_j$ in $v$. No ring or module colimit assertion [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Take the upper tail J above i₀ and its full inclusion F. A common upper bound of i₀ and any original index proves finality; nonemptiness and directedness follow directly.

For j in J let A_j be the entrywise image of A₀ under the transition ring map and Q_j = B(Fj)^n / range(A_j.toLin'). Ring maps induce additive semilinear coordinate maps and preserve the relation submodules, giving quotient transition maps. The map f after entrywise κ kills all relations by hA and exactness, giving the cocone ν. Identity, composition and naturality follow on quotient representatives.

The classes of the standard coordinate vectors generate Q_j. A finite-type integer algebra is countable, as a quotient of a polynomial ring in finitely many variables over ℤ. Its finite powers and their quotients are countable and hence small in Type v. Transport Q_j and all maps and module actions through actual Shrink equivalences. This constructs small stage objects rather than choosing arbitrary witnesses of unproved existence.

Tensor the presentations with B(Fj) or S. Tensor right exactness and the finite-product tensor equivalence identify them with the transported matrices. Over a later stage the resulting quotient is Q_j; over S exactness of g,f identifies it with M. The induced linear equivalences have the required pure-tensor formula, which is preserved by the small-model transports.
